ablation: replace standardized online-AR forecast surprise with standardized raw market-residual return while preserving the same 5-day persistence rule, rebalance schedule and allocation
allocation: Monday fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash; strict ineligibility exits persist until next scheduled rebalance
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier A-M development evidence and the Ebenezar profile campaign are already observed. Frontier-N is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: weekly fixed-slot portfolios should keep turnover bounded; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: the forecast-error signal collapses to ordinary residual momentum because the tiny causal AR forecast adds no economically useful information
falsifier: rotate standardized forecast surprises across currently eligible assets on each date before persistence aggregation, preserving each date's cross-sectional surprise distribution
nearest_incumbent: residual_momentum lineage; distinct object is realized error from a lagged, rolling, per-asset AR(1) forecast with an explicit multi-day surprise-persistence state
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive 5-day sum of standardized forecast surprise with at least 3 positive surprise days; top-K deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Priority-1 online_forecast_surprise frontier from configs/research_frontier.yaml; no Frontier-N market return observed before preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or raw-residual ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: If a liquid crypto asset repeatedly realizes positive market-residual returns above what its own causal AR(1) dynamics predicted, that sequence may represent under-assimilated idiosyncratic information rather than ordinary residual momentum.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; AR coefficients are estimated from target/predictor pairs ending at t-1 and all rolling state is causal and <=365 days
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-N selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
